descriptionHtml:
Indulge in elegance with our Plus Size Chiffon Short Sleeves Pleated V-Neck A-Line Midi Wedding Guest Dress. Designed for comfort and style, the flattering A-line silhouette and pleated details complement the chic V-neck. Short sleeves add a touch of sophistication to this midi-length dress, making it the perfect choice for curvy wedding guests seeking timeless charm.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length:Tea length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
